description: A company's financial statements exactly as filed: income statement, balance sheet, cash flow and equity statement from its 10-K (or 10-Q), with its own line labels, each line's XBRL concept and the values as the filing shows them (units say the scale). Joins several filings by period; a line a later filing restated, or that a stock split changed, is shown beside its first-reported figure, never mixed in.

filed_before.description: Start from the latest filing on or before this date: what was known then.

filings.description: How many 10-Ks (or 10-Qs) to read and join by period, newest first; default 1. One 10-K holds three years of income and cash flows and two balance sheets, so 2 covers four years and 3 covers five.

fiscal_year.description: Start from the 10-K for the fiscal year ending in this calendar year (or the latest 10-Q of it).

period.description: annual (10-K, default) or quarterly (10-Q: each quarter and the year to date; the fourth quarter is only in the 10-K's year).

statement.description: Which statement: income, balance_sheet, cash_flow, comprehensive_income, equity; core (default) is the first three, all is every one.

name: financial_statements

outputSchema.description: Each statement has columns (line, concept, then one per period) and rows as filed, with its units and source R pages; revised lists figures a newer filing changed, other_basis the periods left out because an older filing is on another basis.

title: Financial statements as filed
